goal: Validate the real taxi1 summon-to-payment flow end to end and bridge server-confirmed TELE10 settlements into the durable SQLite Summon Ledger V1 with queryable structured events.
notes: Integration/test branch only. Real economic trade mutations remain one-shot and fail-closed with no automatic retry after uncertain send. Live customer is taxi1 with real character resolved by char enum; octowar1 is not used as the test customer. The SQLite bridge consumes only durable TELE10 settlement evidence and produces idempotent structured events; it does not perform game mutations.
